title: Sword Blocking
body:
# Sword Blocking

This datapack brings back the ability to block with a sword in Minecraft! Originally a feature in older versions of the game, the ability to block attacks with a sword was removed. With this datapack, the classic sword-blocking mechanic is revived and seamlessly integrated into modern Minecraft versions.

### Features:
- **Sword Blocking**: Hold the right mouse button key while wielding a sword to block incoming attacks. Blocking significantly reduces the damage you take.
- **Compatible with All Sword Types**: Whether you're using a wooden, stone, iron, gold, diamond, or netherite sword – blocking works with all of them!
- **Strategic Combat**: Use blocking to gain tactical advantages in fights, especially against melee mobs or incoming projectiles like arrows.
- **Easy Installation**: No mods needed – just drop the datapack into your world folder and start playing!

### How to Install:
1. Download the datapack and place it in the `datapacks` folder of your world.
2. Reload the world or use the `/reload` command.
3. Enjoy the classic sword-blocking feature!

**ONLY WORKS WITH CRAFTED SWORDS!**

Bring back a touch of nostalgia to your Minecraft experience and defend yourself like a true knight on the battlefield with the **Sword Blocking Datapack**! 🛡️
